paper.title: NavHarness: Adaptive Goals for Agentic Vision-Language Navigation
paper.central_claim: Adaptive local goals paired with observation-based completion verification maintain route consistency, and verified-completion memory compression reduces context overhead while retaining navigation capability; NavHarness improves zero-shot VLN and reports 83.3% physical success.

evidence.quote: The Verify Agent produces qualitative feedback p_{t+1} that answers q_{k} , identifies supporting observational evidence, and reports unmet or uncertain conditions.
evidence.support_explanation: Explicit semantic completion feedback drives continuation/revision, not a numeric truth-certified detector.

evidence.quote: After compression, the updated memory replaces the detailed completed segment in the shared context.
evidence.support_explanation: Actual persisted state change is within-episode summarized history/keyframes, not model learning or reusable cross-episode improvement.

evidence.quote: Codex CLI and NavHarness share backbones, episodes, and observation/action interfaces
evidence.support_explanation: Useful same-model/harness comparison; complete compute caps still need checking.

evidence.quote: With GPT-6-Astra, NavHarness achieves 79.0% and 82.5% SR on R2R-CE and RxR-CE, improving over Codex CLI by 5.0 and 6.2 points.
evidence.support_explanation: Author-reported main gains use compression Off, not full Goal compression system.

evidence.quote: GPT-6-Astra saves 5.52% and 4.05%, with SR decreases of 2 and 1.5 points and an RxR-CE SPL decline from 64.7 to 58.3
evidence.support_explanation: Strong-backbone cumulative savings are modest with path-efficiency harm; selected local context reductions cannot be substituted for episode savings.

evidence.quote: This framework-level comparison does not isolate goal generation from verification.
evidence.support_explanation: Paper expressly recognizes the bundled causal limitation.

evidence.locator: Appendix C.4 stop handling; fixed text line 30
evidence.quote: Verification feedback supports the stop decision, but the inspected action interface does not impose an additional mechanical verification gate on STOP.
evidence.support_explanation: Do not misclassify semantic advice as an externally enforced safe STOP gate.

evidence.locator: Appendix D efficiency accounting; fixed text line 33
evidence.quote: Efficiency averages include successful and failed episodes with complete usage records and exclude incomplete records.
evidence.support_explanation: Includes failure cost but introduces potentially selective missing-usage cohort without listed excluded counts.

evidence.locator: Appendix E real-world trials; fixed text line 36
evidence.quote: Each route is tested three times with NavHarness, yielding 24 trials.
evidence.support_explanation: Counted physical execution, unlike uncounted qualitative demonstration.

evidence.quote: NavHarness achieves 83.3% SR and 1.51 m NE
evidence.support_explanation: Approximately 20/24 physical successes reported; baseline values are supplied aggregates rather than newly matched reruns.

evidence.quote: obstacles outside its field of view can remain unobserved, leading to unsafe movements of the quadruped robot.
evidence.support_explanation: Verification does not close obstacle safety or body-awareness failure.

evidence.locator: Appendix F case interpretation; fixed text line 39
evidence.quote: Goal and verification annotations are scene-aligned explanatory reconstructions, rather than verbatim logged outputs
evidence.support_explanation: Illustrative cases do not independently validate the agent's actual verification accuracy.

evidence.locator: 4.3 weaker-backbone token tradeoff; fixed text line 18
evidence.quote: GPT-5.6-Sol saves 35.94% on R2R-CE and 56.59% on RxR-CE, with SR decreases of 1 and 2 points relative to Off
evidence.support_explanation: More substantial savings for weaker backbone; effect is model-dependent.

signatures.object: Local navigation goal and completion state
signatures.information: Instruction, forward RGB, executed action receipts and history; no reference trajectory, destination distance or evaluator label
signatures.operation: Goal agent emits local goal plus question; actor executes primitive batches; verifier checks next observation and routes continue/revise/advance
signatures.output: Adaptive goal state and physical/simulated navigation trajectory
signatures.conditions: Observable goal condition and sufficiently accurate qualitative VLM judgments
signatures.feedback: Post-execution RGB and actual action record; semantic verification not independent environment truth
signatures.selection_rule: Completion advances goal; mismatch revises; uncertainty continues
signatures.selection_data: Online episode evidence, not search-validation data
signatures.persistence: Current goal, verification feedback and memory within episode; no weight/harness updates
signatures.later_use: Subsequent decisions in same route read preserved unresolved state
signatures.failure_boundary: STOP can bypass semantic verification; unvalidated false-completion judgments may propagate

signatures.information: Past goal/action/observation/verification segment and previous memory
signatures.operation: At verified completion summarize route/landmarks/corrections and retain keyframe, replacing completed raw segment; revision alone does not clear it
signatures.output: Compact within-episode memory plus unsummarized active segment
signatures.conditions: Verifier identifies correct boundary and summarizer retains unfinished state
signatures.selection_rule: Compress only verified completion, not any goal revision
signatures.selection_data: Same ongoing episode, no across-task candidate search
signatures.persistence: Memory m and current-segment history r; episode lifetime only
signatures.later_use: All agents consume updated memory on next goal/decision
signatures.claimed_effect: Lower input tokens and images per decision without losing route state
signatures.failure_boundary: False verification or summary omission can irreversibly erase needed context; strong-backbone SR/SPL declines observed

gap.author_gap: Plausible local actions can diverge from route progress; accumulating multimodal history grows inference overhead.
gap.checked_gap: Explicit conditional routing and compression is a concrete response; matched Codex comparisons support bundle-level utility, not an isolated demonstration that verification accuracy is the cause.

lineage.relation: Self-Monitoring/Regretful progress, SmartWay recovery, ReAct/Reflexion and navigation history summaries precede adaptive goal-question-completion compression coupling.

closest_adjacent.source: SmartWay 2503.10069v2, also assigned fixed material, used only after its independent review; current gap evidence here is Appendix A description
closest_adjacent.limitation: No claim of exhaustive novelty. Other direct neighbors AgenticNav/HarnessVLN originals absent from packet.

gap.residue: Connect observed local accomplishment to goal advancement and context replacement, preserving unresolved evidence.
gap.stakes: Long-horizon route errors and repeated context processing; table shows token burden can still exceed native runtime.
gap.remaining_gap: Verifier accuracy, hard stop enforcement, independent dev/test disclosure, component disentanglement, physical obstacle safety.
unresolved: Original nearest-neighbor methods beyond fixed packet needed for stronger novelty ruling; shared re-fixed supplement only.

claims.text: Adaptive goals and verification improve route execution
claims.baseline/control: Codex CLI matched GPT-5.6-Sol/GPT-6-Astra; three-backbone R2R check
claims.selection_vs_test: No explicit held-out harness-development list; published comparator protocols are contextual
claims.result/denominator: Astra Off SR 79/82.5 versus 74/76.3; Sol +4.4/+6.0; noninteger rates despite 100 listed episodes leave run aggregation underspecified
counterevidence: Goals and verifier not isolated; no simulation paired uncertainty
Unvalidated qualitative verifier; STOP can execute directly
claims.allowed_conclusion: Descriptive matched-backbone bundle gains, not demonstrated isolated verifier mechanism or statistically robust superiority to all trained policies.

claims.text: Progress-aware compression reduces overhead while retaining useful navigation context
claims.setting: Off versus Goal on same framework and two models/datasets
claims.baseline/control: All model calls/compression overhead recorded; incomplete usage episodes removed
claims.selection_vs_test: Local trace examples selected; not episode savings
claims.result/denominator: Sol total savings 35.94/56.59%; Astra 5.52/4.05%; SR losses 1-2 points and Astra RxR SPL 64.7 to 58.3
counterevidence: Quality degrades and strong-model uncompressed tokens can exceed native runtime; missing-record selection unquantified
claims.allowed_conclusion: Measured backbone-dependent token/quality tradeoff, not cost-free universal compression gain.

claims.setting: Go2, front RGB only, eight indoor/outdoor routes, three trials each
claims.baseline/control: Supplied recorded aggregates, no fully matched baseline protocol
claims.result/denominator: Approximately 20 successes of 24 trials; no per-route results in text
counterevidence: Unsafe off-camera obstacle moves; illustrative goal/verification annotations reconstructed
claims.allowed_conclusion: Counted real deployment feasibility in selected routes, not general safe autonomy or causal verification proof.

assessment.strongest_supported_claim: Author-reported matched-backbone VLN gains for the goal/verification bundle, memory token savings with explicit quality losses, and counted Go2 deployment support scoped sim-to-physical transfer. No independent reproduction, isolated verifier effect, calibrated checker reliability or universal efficiency dominance established.
unresolved: Simulation rate denominators/run aggregation behind fractional rates on 100 listed episodes
